source.snippet: Last quarter our OpenAI bill went from $620 to $2,480 in 23 days. No new features shipped. No traffic spike. A silent bug was causing redundant API calls in a retry loop — and there was no alerting, no budget cap enforcement, and no per-feature cost attribution to catch it until the invoice arrived.

problem_statement: Engineering teams using LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) have no real-time per-feature cost attribution or anomaly alerting, so runaway bugs silently multiply API spend by 3-4x before the monthly invoice surfaces the damage.
target_segment: SaaS startups and dev teams that have shipped AI features and are paying $200–$5,000/month in LLM API costs.
notes: Buyer is clearly paying (existing OpenAI bill of $620/month baseline). Post has 12 points and 3 comments on dev.to — concrete dollar amounts cited ($1,800 overage). Willingness-to-pay implied: team would have paid for alerting to avoid $1,860 surprise. Adjacent to existing APM/observability tools but LLM-specific cost attribution is an unserved gap. Solo operator could build a lightweight middleware/SDK layer with a dashboard and per-endpoint cost alerts.
